event: Arlequino delegates remaining pre-festival concert organization to Meira

canon.meira_authority: Handle remaining organization and return only for decisions she cannot reasonably make herself.
canon.venue_rule: Prefer city venue if at least 10000 spectators can be safely accommodated; 10000 is a minimum, larger capacity preferred; otherwise use out-of-city venue.
canon.pricing_reference: Use Blumund model already stated by Arlequino as reference; exact Eurazania layout depends on venue geometry.
